headline: Powell says restoring *price stability* will require economic pain
quote: I wish there were a painless way to do that.
title: Powell, Sep 2022: There is no painless way to lower inflation
caption: In September 2022, the Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 75 basis points for the third consecutive time. Chair Jerome Powell emphasized that bringing inflation back to the two percent goal requires restrictive policy.
comment: Do you think the Fed's rate hikes were necessary to tame inflation?
